prompts.Red: Create a production game VFX sprite sheet, one horizontal row of EXACTLY FIVE equally sized square cells on a truly TRANSPARENT background. Target overall canvas aspect 5:1 (2560x512), five 512x512 cells, no borders, labels, text or grid. This is ONE red paintbrush crescent swipe evolving over time, not five different designs. Style reference image1 is our game's coarse pixel art brush: copy its crisp stepped pixel clusters, flat limited-color shading, no antialiasing/no blur. Image2 is MOTION/SILHOUETTE reference ONLY: the huge thick curved brushstroke wrapping around an empty center; do NOT include characters, brush, game UI, background, writing, or black paint. Draw a bold RED C-shaped paint arc OPEN TO THE RIGHT, wide heavy uneven stroke around a transparent oval center. Its upper-right leading start is broad and lower-right ending tapers into 2-3 ragged brush-tip points. Use only a dark maroon edge, saturated coral-red main body, and a broad light salmon highlight band along the stroke, with ZERO glow, ZERO soft transparency. Keep identical fixed center, axis, footprint, scale and margins across all five cells (a 384px diameter arc inside each 512 cell, center at256,256). Frame1: short broad red upper curve beginning at upper-right, occupying its eventual position on the full arc. Frame2: stroke has swept across top and left, forming half of the eventual C. Frame3: strong complete broad C-shaped crescent, its thick lower-left mass and sharply tapered lower-right tips define the main impact, no perfect geometric ring. Frame4: same C stroke starts breaking up into 3 large curved sections with ragged gaps; preserve its position and silhouette. Frame5: only 3-4 small curved paint remnants remain at the locations of the arc tips and outer edge, center still transparent. Coherent hand animated sprite frames on common registration; no speed lines extending past cell margins, no disconnected decorative sparkles, no droplets outside the crescent. The red palette should be similar to RGB238,67,59 main, RGB164,52,51 shade, RGB255,140,103 highlight. Pixel art only. Transparent alpha must also fill the inner hole and empty frame areas.
